stories.title: NFL commish Goodell agrees to 4-year extension
stories.summary: NFL commissioner Roger Goodell has finalized a new four-season extension that runs through the 2030 season.

stories.title: Sabalenka into US Open quarters over Townsend
stories.summary: Top-ranked Aryna Sabalenka found a groove after some early struggles to hold serve and overpower Taylor Townsend to reach the quarterfinals of the US Open.

stories.title: U-M wins on controversial finish; B1G backs review
stories.summary: Michigan got a second chance at a Hail Mary and connected in a 13-12 stunner over Western Michigan, as the Big Ten confirmed that officials correctly added time back on the clock to give the Wolverines another shot.

stories.title: Arsenal edge past Chelsea in vintage derby win
stories.summary: Arsenal came from behind to record a statement 2-1 win in a vintage London derby against Chelsea at the Emirates on Sunday.

stories.title: Drama, delay doesn't dampen Kiffin's LSU debut
stories.summary: Arizona State transfer quarterback Sam Leavitt and Wisconsin transfer running back Dilin Jones combined for four rushing touchdowns in their new uniforms, and LSU ended a week of off-the-field drama with an easy 51-10 victory over Clemson.
